title: Tessie Vehicle Snapshot Weekly Rated Range Trend
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tessie:vehicle range_km=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(range_km) as avg_duration, max(range_km) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst rated range for Tessie vehicle snapshot events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture range_km on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average rated range with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews whether Tessie vehicle snapshot tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
